newsitem.title: USA: United Airlines cuts domestic fares 45 pct.
newsitem.headline: United Airlines cuts domestic fares 45 pct.

text.p: United Airlines said Wednesday it is lowering domestic airfares an average of 45 percent systewide in response to similar cuts by American Airlines and to stimulate leisure travel.
Tickets must be purchased by September 30. The fares cover travel from September 25 to February 13, but some holidays are excluded from the lower rates, the airline said.
United is a subsidiary of UAL Corp. American Airlines is a subsidiary of AMR Corp.
